remarks: **ALL OFFERS DUE MONDAY 11/3 at 6PM ** Fantastic opportunity as a primary home or an addition to an investor's portfolio! Welcome to this beautifully maintained side-by-side 2-family home ideal for investors or owner-occupants. Each unit offers 3 beds, 1.5 baths, separate utilities, and updates!  Unit 1 features a stunning remodeled eat-in kitchen (2020) with white shaker cabinets, granite countertops, tile backsplash, new flooring, dishwasher, and microwave. The spacious, sun-filled living room includes crown molding, built-ins, and an elegant electric fireplace. A convenient half bath is located off the kitchen, while upstairs you'll find 2 guest bedrooms, a large primary bedroom, and a recently updated full bath all complimented by hardwood flooring. Unit 2 offers refinished hardwood floors, a brand new tankless hot water system (2024), and a large eat-in kitchen with granite countertops, tile backsplash, and half bath. The bright living room has large windows, and upstairs includes a full bath, 2 guest rooms, and a primary bedroom. This unit is handicap accessible, with a ramp and stair chair. The property is fully fenced in, has ample parking, and the driveway was just sealcoated. Both units feature full basements with laundry and extra room for storage or even potential space to be finished! This property is tenant-ready and ideal for generating strong rental income or comfortable owner occupancy.
